gaps.sentence: This old house needs doing ___ before winter.
gaps.explanation: do up = repair and decorate a building. (British usage)

gaps.sentence: The subject cropped ___ again at dinner.
gaps.explanation: crop up = appear or happen unexpectedly.

gaps.sentence: I had to turn ___ their invitation because I was ill.
gaps.explanation: turn down = reject an offer/invitation; turn up = appear.

gaps.sentence: He ___ up the word in an online dictionary.
gaps.explanation: 'Look a word up' = check its meaning.

gaps.sentence: The old buses are being phased ___ next year.
gaps.explanation: phase out = stop using something gradually.

gaps.sentence: Police are looking ___ the cause of the crash.
He stole the pens and got away ___ it.
gaps.explanation: get away with something = do wrong without being punished.
